entry.title: Pokemon HGSS v0.9.0r2
entry.content:
# Pokemon HeartGold / SoulSilver APWorld - v0.2.4-hotfix
Bug-fix release on top of v0.2.4, based on playtester reports. **Compatible with games already in progress**
## How to update
1. Replace `pokemon_hgss.apworld` in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder with the one attached below. 2. Re-open your existing `.apheartgold` file as usual. Your save is kept.
- **Client fixes** apply as soon as the apworld is updated. - **ROM fixes** apply when you re-open your `.apheartgold` with this version. - **Logic fixes** only affect newly generated seeds.
## Fixes
### Logic (new seeds) - **Cliff Edge Gate no longer requires Rock Climb.** The gate between Cianwood and Route 47 is a plain walk-through: only the Secret Potion is needed, as in vanilla. Route 47, Route 48 and their checks are no longer pushed to the late game. - **Dead seeds through the Magnet Train.** The train also needs the Kanto Power Plant repaired, which the logic ignored (a real seed put HM03 Surf on Route 12). - `magnet_train` on (default): the Power Plant counts as repaired from the start. The train works as soon as you have the Pass, and the Machine Part quest is skipped along with its TM57 location. Requires the matching client. - `magnet_train` off: the train only counts once the Power Plant has really been repaired. - **The Copycat's Pass** now requires the Power Plant repair when `magnet_train` is off, since her Lost Item only appears after it. - **Bell Tower and Lugia monks.** The monks never check your bag: each one only lets you through once the NPC who hands out that wing has done so. The logic now requires talking to that NPC: - HeartGold: the Radio Tower director (Goldenrod) for the Rainbow Wing, the old man in Pewter City for the Silver Wing. - SoulSilver: the other way round.
Both wings are now merely useful items.
### Client (games in progress included) - **Goal is now reported to the server**, so "release on goal" and other goal-based settings finally trigger. This covers `elite_four`, `champion_red` and `n_badges`. - **Vermilion Gym could become impossible** if the Thunder Badge arrived before beating Lt. Surge. The client now hides the badge while you are in Vermilion City or its gym, until Surge is beaten. If you are stuck inside the gym, walk out and back in. - **Whiteout sent you back to New Bark** with `randomize_start_location` before your first Pokemon Center visit. You now wake up at your starting town's Pokemon Center. This fix only works on seeds generated with this version.
### ROM (re-open your .apheartgold) - **The Pass trade chain could break.** The Fan Club chairman refused the Lost Item if you already held a Pass, and the Copycat could stop offering her trade after your first talk. - **HeartGold: the Pewter City old man always gave a real Silver Wing** instead of the item placed there.
## Workarounds for games in progress - **Stuck at a wing monk:** talk to the NPC who hands out that wing in your version (listed above), even if you already hold the wing. - **Stuck by the Magnet Train on an older seed:** ask the host for the missing item (`/send` or `!getitem`).

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.16.2
entry.content: ## Changes ### Fixed - Turning off SigMod or Community missions on the Missions page now takes their missions out of the pool. Before, they stayed ticked: the pool looked full, and Check Run Selection still asked for SigMod after you had turned it off. If the start mission was one of them, the start goes back to Any and the server boots on its default map again. By kelly-cs. - A mission that stayed ticked after its requirement went away can be unticked. Its row used to be locked, so it could not be taken out of the pool. - All in the pool no longer puts community missions back while Community missions is off. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * Fix mission pool toggles when SigMod or community missions turn off by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/105 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.16.1...v1.16.2 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/MjAwZGMzMDQ2OWNjZWJhODAwZGFhMTU0N2QxNmYyZDY6MTc4OTYyNTUwMg==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/MjQ4NWRjYThkMmNjZjgyOGI0NzNkZTU0Mzc3OGU1YzY6MTc4OTYyNTUwNA==/detection)

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.0
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **A game already in progress will lose its map colours.** The website updates for everyone at once, and from now on the seed itself tells the client what is in logic. A seed generated before 1.8.0 does not carry that, so its stages show simply as unlocked or completed. Everything else keeps working, and a new seed gets the colours back. - **Regenerate your yaml** for the new options below. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## New options
- **Enforce Logic** — stages that are out of logic cannot be entered at all. They stay on the map, greyed out, so you can still see what you hold. There is no override: the run cannot be broken by accident or on purpose. - **Ring Link** — your gold is linked to every other Ring Link player's rings. Gold you earn sends rings to the room, rings you receive become gold, and spending sends a negative. **Ring Link Ratio** (default 100) sets how much gold one ring is worth in both directions, because Stick Ranger's gold is one to two orders of magnitude larger than the ring counts games like Sonic deal in. - **Gold per Thrown Ring** — every ring an Angel throws pays gold. Defaults to 50, and goes up to 1000. Set it to 0 to turn it off. It ignores the Gold Multiplier and the Gold Medal, so the number you pick is the number you get. Be aware that an Angel throws about two rings a second, or seven on a quick ring, and four of them at the maximum out-earns every enemy in the game.
## Changes
### Logic now comes from the seed
The website used to carry its own copy of the apworld's rules, written by hand and kept in step by hand. That is what went wrong six different ways in 1.6.0.
The apworld now describes its own logic and sends it with the seed, and the website evaluates that instead of a copy. There is no second set of rules left to drift. Checked by comparing 25,500 stage verdicts against Archipelago's own answer across 300 random item states.
This is why an older seed loses its colours: it never sent a description.
### APWorld
- Universal Tracker gets the boss requirements the seed actually rolled, so it stops rolling its own and disagreeing with the game. - New: Enforce Logic, Ring Link, Ring Link Ratio, Gold per Thrown Ring.
### Client
- Every movement of gold now goes through one place, which is what Ring Link watches. What it reports is what actually happened, so a purchase you could not afford or a pickup at the gold cap sends nothing. - Ring Link batches: gold moves constantly here, so instead of a packet per change it totals up and sends at most one every five seconds. The total is added up before being divided, so ten $40 gun shots count as 4 rings rather than ten lots of nothing, and the remainder carries to the next send. - Gold arriving from Ring Link is never sent back out, so two linked Stick Ranger players cannot amplify each other.

entry.title: Dwarf Fortress v2.1.0
entry.content:
A feature release: manual send mode, a reworked Status tab, and a round of check and poll refactors. **2.0.x seeds and worlds remain playable**; the location and item tables are unchanged and the in-fort win condition is the same, so nothing needs regenerating to install this.
### Features
- **Manual send mode.** See Performance below. The Status tab gained a `Manual send` toggle and a `Send now` button, and the **Controls** tab was folded into **Status** now that it has the room. `Reset all AP state` and `Reset seed` ask for confirmation before firing.
### Logic
- **The Legendary Wealth goal now requires the means to produce a treasury.** The goal is measured in minted coins and cut gems, but its completion condition asked only for the Codex, five coffers and immigration waves. The metal chain (Smelter + fuel or magma smelting, plus a Forge or magma forge, and the Coins permit when permits are on) and the Jeweler's Workshop blueprint are now part of it, so those blueprints are treated as goal progression and land in the progression spheres instead of looking optional to the fill.
### Performance
- The **Controls** tab is gone; its three buttons moved onto **Status**, which had the room. `Reset all AP state` and `Reset seed` now ask for confirmation first - they fired on a single keypress before, and they now sit on the tab the panel opens on. - **Manual send mode.** A fort paying more FPS for live checks than it wants can now switch the mod's scanning off entirely: the Status tab has a `Manual send` toggle (Shift-M) and a `Send now` button (Shift-N) that runs exactly one check pass. Also available as `dwarfipelago manual-send on|off` and `dwarfipelago send-now`. Item delivery and the client link are unaffected. Three things stay live while paused: trade-depot placement (it gates all AP item delivery), incoming DeathLinks, and the Archipelago caravan, so a docked caravan still stocks its goods and still registers purchases. The event hooks that record production, crafts and deaths are not part of the poll and keep running too, so a `Send now` flushes real progress rather than starting cold. While it is on, the Checks tab paints every open check **blue** and reports how many are being held, so it is obvious the list is frozen by choice rather than stalled. Locked checks stay red - AP logic blocks those regardless.
- **The completed-check guard was re-reading and re-parsing the whole checked-locations set on every check, every poll.** `is_location_checked` did a persistent read plus a full JSON decode per call, and the poll calls it once per check - 122 static ones plus every craft and skill check. That is O(checks x checked) per tick, and it grows as a run progresses, so it was worst on large craftsanity/skillsanity seeds where the fort is already struggling. The set is now decoded once per frame and kept coherent on write: **122 reads and 122 decodes per poll become 1 and 1**. - **Skillsanity kept scanning every citizen for skills that were already maxed.** `update_skill_levels` walked all ~87 tracked skills against every living citizen on every poll, including skills already recorded at `skillsanity_max_level`, which can never rise again. Maxed skills are now filtered out before any unit is touched, so the cost falls as a run progresses instead of staying flat: with 113 citizens, **9,831 unit lookups per poll drop to 5,311 at half maxed and to zero once all are.** The skill-lowering behaviour still scans, since it actively caps units rather than only observing them. - **The FPS backoff only engaged below 30 FPS**, so a fort that had dropped from 100 to 50-60 - the range people actually report - kept polling at full rate. Anything under 60 now polls at half rate. The low-end factors are unchanged on purpose: the poll interval is measured in ticks, so a slow fort already stretches each poll in real time, and raising them further would delay checks more than it saves. - The client no longer resolves every received item's name on each poll merely to decide that nothing had changed; the change signature is keyed on item ids and names are resolved only when a recompute actually happens.

Because this version is meant for testing, the mod must be installed/updated manually.
To use this version in a new mod profile, look for an option to import a local mod. r2modman users can find this option under Settings > Profile > Import local mod. Gale users can find the option under Import > ..local mod. If your mod manager does not automatically install the required dependencies, you will need to install the latest versions of BepInEx, Archipelago Scrap, and DawnLib.

entry.title: Wario Land 3 v0.7.0
entry.content:
This is a BIG update with A LOT of new features/fixes. This has been tested, but since it's such a big update, there may be (and probably will be) some bugs. It shouldn't be anything gamebreaking, but please let me know if there is. I will label this a pre-release until we've done a bit more testing. This shouldn't be brought to public syncs just yet, but I will add it as stable when it should be.
## New Features
### Shopsanity Adds an entirely new shop to the right of the temple! The options for this include different price tiers: cheap, normal and expensive. Each have weighted prices with 2 at the lower end, 2 towards the top, and 6 in the middle. (There's currently no hard set logic for these checks, as you're able to grind out coins in level as needed).
### New Victory Condition Adds the 10 bosses as a potential win condition. There is also a new option of "bosses_required" (similar to music_boxes_required) where you can choose how many bosses you want as your win condition. This CAN be used in conjunction with boss_defeats granting items.
### Hidden blocks and coins Added a new option under "hidden_blocks_revealed" to ALSO color guaranteed coin blocks differently than normal blocks. This will be useful for grinding out coins... and maybe for something in the future? 👀
## QoL Updates
### Temple update - You can now enter the temple before being able to beat Rudy. He will tell you how many bosses/music boxes you have left before you can fight him.
### Pause Menu Treasure Tracker - Updated the treasure count at the top of the treasure tracker to dynamically show how many locations you've checked (i.e. 10/410). - Replaced the page count at the top right with the win condition requirements you've collected so far. - Added multiple new pages to the treasure tracker menu: - Musical Coin tracker - Keys, bosses and chests tracker (tracks how many you've collected per level) - Transformations treasure page - Shows your "Owned Keys" per level, so you can see what keys you have (G R G B = Grey, Red, Green, Blue)
### Misc.
- Keys are now their vanilla sprites, with a large ACTUALLY readable letter/number for their corresponding level. - Changed a few palettes for in-game text, as well as increasing the text size to be more uniform. - Roll/ice skatin' without transformations on now returns them back to their vanilla states (can't turn) - Pauses are now allowed in boss rooms, so on the off-chance you get soft locked, you can return to the overworld. - Palette shuffle updates to include more saturation randomization. This helps with the lack of colors to choose from, adds a bit more variety. - Crests now replaced by coins. 1 Coin = 1 Coin, 2 slimmer coins = 10, 3 sideways coins = 25 and 4 sideways coins = 50. - Made some yaml changes for conciseness
### Bug Fixes - Scowler blocks finally fixed. - Gold magic spawning waves in N1 fixed. - Glass Eyes door, Golden eyes door and fence all adjusted in Tower of Revival to look as they should if you do not own their items. - Vast Plains finally don't have empty space when you have chemicals but no magic seeds. Coin 6 still needs chemicals or magic seeds to spawn. - Cave of Flames now actually shows rusted blocks correctly, regardless of variant. - Removed a few dust/particles that were still being overwritten by lettering. - Overworld crash now gated so you can't spam right or left in the transition. Should no longer crash - Large blocks are now breakable from above without Garlic. - You should no longer get spammed with item popups after re-connecting. - Probably so much more that I'm forgetting
### Lizzie's Logic Fixes
- Out of the Woods Coin 3 now requires Puffy Form - Added flying past the climbable fencing back to Tower of Revival - Added rolling past currents into easy glitches logic - Added using the blue key/chest door to get past the warps without warp removal apparatus into knowledge check logic - Added getting Castle of Illusions coins 2 and 3 via wall jump to all glitches logic

entry.title: Brotato v0.15.0r3
entry.content:
## Added - New Feature: Progressive Wave Caps - The game now has a cap on the highest wave that can be played from the start. - A set of new items, "Progressive Wave Cap (\<character\>)", has been added which, when received, increases the maximum playable wave for each character. - The logic for Wave Completed and Run Won locations now requires that the wave cap be greater than the wave number or 20, respectively. - Controlled by a new option, `wave_caps`, which sets the number Progressive Wave Cap Increase items for each character and the increase given by each one. - There are predefined values for `wave_caps`: - `one`: One wave cap, all 20 waves are reachable from the start (matches previous apworld behavior). - `two`: Waves 1-10 are playable from the start, waves 11-20 require a cap increase. - `four`: Waves 1-5 are playable from the start, 6-10 require a single increase, 11-15 require two, 16-20 require three. - `ten`: Waves 1-2 are playable from the start, 3-4 require one increase, etc. - `twenty`: Every wave past wave 1 requires a cap increase. - Added Universal Tracker hooks to the apworld so it now uses the same characters as the actual slot.
## Changed
- Reduced the maximum values of some options that were unfun at larger values: - `num_victories` is now 25 instead of matching the total number of characters. - `num_common_crate_drops` is now 25 instead of 50. - `num_legendary_crate_drops` is now 10 instead of 50. - The amount of wins to unlock each group of loot crate checks has been adjusted so the thresholds are evenly distributed over the number of wins needed to goal. - Before, the last group could be unlocked much earlier in logic if the number of groups did not evenly divide into the number of wins needed.

entry.title: Crash Team Racing v0.2.1a2
entry.content:
This prerelease adds the new Hit Character checks, lets Cortex Vortex (the Oxide 2 track since alpha1) also appear as an optional regular race track, and adjusts boost requirements for Platinum Time Trials and boss races. It is available for testing and feedback. **v0.2.0 remains the latest stable release.**
## Getting started
Download `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.1-alpha2-windows-x86.zip` for Windows or `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.1-alpha2-linux-x86.tar.gz` for Linux and Steam Deck. Each contains the client and matching `ctr.apworld`; use both together for a new game. Follow the [CTR setup guide](https://ap-pie.com/guides/ctr). You need your own NTSC-U Crash Team Racing disc; no game assets are included.
## What's new since alpha1
- **Hit Character (new option, off by default):** Adds a check for hitting each of the sixteen racers. Races can include unlocked guest racers. Hit locations are awarded when you hit the corresponding opponent, and the race roster rotates so unlocked, unchecked guests can appear. With Itemsanity on, you need a Bomb or Missile item before Hit locations are in logic. Hit checks and guest unlocks were confirmed in a Steam session on the release executable. - **Cortex Vortex as a regular track:** Cortex Vortex shipped in alpha1 as the default Oxide 2 track. A new optional setting (off by default) can also place it on a warp pad and in Gem Cups, with Trophy, Time Trial, CTR Token, letter, podium and Wumpa checks. Oxide's Final Challenge still uses it by default. Its relic targets currently use Oxide Station's times; custom target times are pending from the track author. A missing start line and noisy glass textures on this track are fixed, confirmed in a Steam session. Relic Races and CTR Challenges on Cortex Vortex load correctly in a Steam session, but finishing them and their checks have not been confirmed yet; please report whether their checks send. - **Boost logic:** Platinum Time Trials require two Progressive Boosts on Easy and Medium. With Blue Fire enabled, Easy Platinum trials require three. Hard keeps its track-specific requirements. Boss wins require at least one boost; a venue that needs more to finish raises the requirement, including Pinstripe on Hot Air Skyway and Oxide on Oxide Station. Oxide Station's physical T and R letters and full CTR Challenge now require two Boosts even when Hard Shortcut Knowledge permits an earlier Trophy finish. These are generation-logic changes and have not been confirmed in a complete Steam seed. - **Race fixes:** The extra-racer model load that made racers invisible in boss and relic races is fixed in source. Recorded AI now uses the correct custom-track identity on Cortex Vortex. The boss and relic race fix was confirmed in a Steam session on the release executable. - **Other fixes:** Trial race pad previews were corrected; a warp pad's second unlock stage is now strictly stronger than its first when both use the same item type; the Tiger Temple token logic was corrected. The `relic_count: all` YAML alias again means 18 under the default single-tier relic mode. - **Adventure tracker preview:** A prototype minimap tracker is included. Its visual design and some location placement need further work.
## Before you play
- This is a prerelease. Hit Character, boss and relic races passed a short Steam session on the release executable, but no complete seed has been played on it yet. Report any invisible racer, missing Hit check, or misplaced crate with the exact seed, settings and `ctr-ap.log`. - AP item boxes may appear in a boss race even when that track's regular warp pad is locked. This remains a known issue. - Existing rooms should keep the apworld that generated them for their server and Universal Tracker. The new Hit Character block uses schema 2 and requires a matching alpha2 client for those seeds.
Report problems through the [issue tracker](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues) with the client version, platform, YAML, reproduction steps and `ctr-ap.log`. The Windows and Linux bundles include a support-bundle script for gathering diagnostic files.
## Downloads and technical details
The ZIP and tarball are the player downloads. The separate `ctr.apworld` and `Crash.Team.Racing.yaml` are provided for hosts and generators. The `.sha256` files verify downloads; `ctr_native_ap.exe.debug` and `ctr_native_ap.debug` help diagnose Windows and Linux crashes. The client is not code-signed, and no antivirus clearance is claimed.
Client and apworld compatibility version: **0.2.1**. Build label: **v0.2.1-alpha2**. Source is tagged `v0.2.1-alpha2` in both repositories.
## What's next
Gather feedback from the community test sessions, refine the Adventure tracker, and replace Cortex Vortex's placeholder relic times when the track author supplies targets. Broader custom-track support remains a later campaign.

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.17.0
entry.content: ## Changes ### Two new mission modifiers - **Mental.** The robots, the tanks and their buildings stay cloaked for the whole wave. A normal hit makes one shimmer for a moment; a reveal-on-hit weapon buff decloaks it properly for five seconds before it fades back. - **Make it Count.** Your non-melee weapons and your sentries hit for two and a half times as much, and in exchange RED carries a quarter of the reserve ammo and the Engineer a quarter of the metal. Dispensers top you up every four seconds rather than continuously. - Both by kelly-cs, and both are drawn per mission like the rest: a mission keeps the modifiers it was given for the whole run. ### SigMod missions on a Windows server - **The 99 community missions that need SigMod now run on Windows.** They were listed and locked there because rafradek publishes a Linux server build only. The extension is now cross-compiled for Windows in `m-this/sigsegv-mvm-win`, and the launcher downloads and verifies it the same way it does the Linux one. - Turn on **SigMod** on the Missions page and press **Download / set up selected server mods**, exactly as on Linux. Nothing installs it otherwise: it is only needed by missions that ask for it, and a run without one never downloads it. ### Fixed - **Defender bots ready up again after a map change.** A per-client ready-command deadline kept the previous map's game clock, so the bots stopped pressing F4 until the new map's clock had caught up with it. On a mission switch that could leave the team standing in the spawn room. - **A bot is no longer called "// Managed by tf2ap. Edits here".** The names file the launcher writes starts with a managed-file comment, and the mod read that line as a name and let the game cut it at 31 characters. Reported with a screenshot by Cowser the Khelinace. - **Adding a bot name works again.** Typing a name on the Bots page and pressing Add this name answered `settings action "bots.name_add" is not wired` and added nothing. Reported by Cowser the Khelinace. - **A Windows server no longer hangs when the mission changes.** The bots walked navigation areas left over from the previous map and the server never came back, with nothing in the log after the last bot finished shopping. Since a run changes mission by changing map, every switch could meet it. - **Bot Surge waves that stalled now recover.** On some wave patterns the endless support robots respawned fast enough to hold every enemy slot, so the wave itself stopped progressing, Cybernetic Carnage wave 1 among them. After twenty seconds with no progress and no tank alive, the support is cleared for four seconds to let the wave through. By kelly-cs. - **Docker: the defender bots load again.** The v1.16.1 server image built its two native extensions against a newer C library than the image runs, so SourceMod could load neither and no bots joined. By kelly-cs. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * fix(bots): build Linux extensions against server glibc by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/106 * feat(modifiers): add Mental cloak mode by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/111 * fix(mvm): recover stalled Bot Surge waves using BLU support only by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/107 * fix(testmode): honor Docker options and award eligible check rewards by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/108 * feat(modifiers): add Make it Count by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/112 * Wire Add this name on the Bots page by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/116 * Build CBaseNPC for Windows with the nav-cache patch by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/114 * SigMod missions run on a Windows server by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/113 * Cache and pin the CBaseNPC and Actions build by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/117 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.16.2...v1.17.0 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/YzgxNTdlMDZhNDlkYjI2NWJiN2FjOTA3MWM0Y2FiY2Y6MTc4OTcyNjYxNQ==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/MzczMjQ0MjAyZWI2N2FlYzM4MThlNzQwM2UzODE4ZjU6MTc4OTcyNjYxNw==/detection)

entry.title: Tomba! v1.5.8
entry.content:
This release is mostly focussed on ER (entrance randomization): It brings various stability fixes to prevent desynchronization with the various randomized entrances.
> [!WARNING] > The entrance randomization feature is a higly unstable option right now. Any issues should be reported on this project tracker page: https://github.com/T4g1/ArchipelagoTomba/issues
---
## ✨ What's New
### 🐛 Bug Fixes * Queue event actions so its not done too soon and overriden by the game's code: Fix A Drink For Grownup not being forced clear from the start * Removed Ol' Pond entrance from randomized entrances to allow clearing the Take me home event * Removed flower tower entrance from randomized entrances to avoid softlock with flower tears * Typo in Death Fuit missing an R * Better transition updates handling: The updates are now handled at first frame of being out of loading. Going in inventory reloads the transitions too and leaving boss fights also updates them * Yan Father giving the lunch box location was no longer working * Removed Lava Caves exits from randomized entrances to avoid glitch when getting there before having purified it. * Fix being killed for some reason when going to Stormy Mountains: Issue in transition being modified * Fix Baccus Door not unlocked as it should because the change was overwritten by the game being loaded * Clock Tower cutscene causes randomization to be overriden by original destination * Clear the fog event was never cleared upon entering the 100 YOM's hut due to game state never being out of dialog * Blue Powder and Healing Mushrooms no longer dispatched as they should * Masakari River is no longer randomized except for the Old Tree Hill * Clear the Fog and Furious Tornado are no longer randomized in entrance randomization runs * Removes rewards and notifications for event that are force cleared in entrance randomization mode * Clear the Fog is now cleared in ER but the furious tornado is still accessible at the start of the run as the Fog can't be removed dynamically yet * Underground prison removed from ER pool to avoid softlocks * Fix issue where Saving/Loading the game would reset ER
---
## 🔧 Installation 1. Download the source code or the `.apworld` file. 2. Drop it into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` directory.

entry.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong v0.4.6
entry.content:
Probably the most massive update in terms of logic, also lots of other new randomization options and fixes **Already started runs do not work if you update. You'll either have to start a new seed or wait with updating until old one is done** (Also as usual if you like what I do and wann [buy me a coffee](https://streamlabs.com/batatvideogames/tip) I'd appreciate it)
## Changelog
### Big Changes
- **Massive logic overhaul, 794 of 863 locations now have logic and improved graphs** - Old Hearts rando option added (conjoined hearts remains vanilla until verdania is mapped) - Hermit Soul, Maiden Soul and Seeker Soul rando option added - Eva and her 5 rewards are now options (for crest slot rando it does in fact depend on how many of those you get) - Bellshrine-sanity: the shrine doors are closed/open not depending on if you hit the lever but if you own the respective bell item - Fixed Diving Bell progression, the Shamans at the beginning of Act 3 properly give the quest needed - Complete rework of Vog hints. You buy information on how many progression items are left in an area rather than WotH/Foolish/General hints (they also no longer bog down multiworlds) - Act 2 and 3 items now in Act 1 wincon pool, Act 3 items now in pool of Act 2/Cursed wincon - New option to determined Silk and Soul points needed (between 0-24). This does not get rid of the other requirements needed - Full map has a crosshair now so people don't struggle with seeing where their cursor is - (by Skai) Received items now have icons that properly display what item they are rather than the generic rosary-AP symbol
### Bugfixes / Other

entry.title: Spyro: A Hero's Tail v2.2.0
entry.content:
# v2.2.0 (Prerelease): I Think I Like AHT Too Much... *Intended for use with game mod version 17 (see attachments).*
v2.2 contains *way* more than originally planned for it. It transitioned from "the next few things on my mind" to "do everything I can before I feel OK with putting it down for a bit". The to-do list still isn't totally empty, so there may still be a v2.3 in the relatively near future, but I don't anticipate any more *big* updates as there really aren't many other moderate-to-big sized features left to add at this point. # Changelog ## Multiple New or Redesigned/Expanded Features * The PAL GC version of the game is now supported by the game mod! Shoutouts to @BrinchEbsen for tons of work on the game mod in this update. * Logging system redesigned to be a single choice of level of detail. Warning messages from YAML issues are now always logged. * The randomized shop system has been moderately redesigned to take more advantage of the gem logic system introduced in v2.0. - `gem_logic` is now `shop_logic` and comes in 2 forms: - `ordered` works identically to `gem_logic = true`. - `unordered` is a replacement for `gem_logic = false` which completely removes the situation of having all shop items in logic in sphere 1. `unordered` will instead expect you to buy shop items in order as you gain access to enough gems to do them, but will not *restrict* you from buying them in another order if desired. - Also, `shop_item_count` lets you customize how many shop items you have, now separated from `key_rings`. * The goal system has been expanded to allow for customization of how many AHT checks you must do for each, instead of all-or-nothing. AHT is now capable of a much wider variety of seeds, and is better suited for shorter goal syncs now. 2 new types of goals were added, as well (talking to elders, and minigames). `/check_goal` was redesigned to better suit this redesign. * `auto_corrections` expanded to `fix_minor` and `fix_major`. Minor fixes are things that are relatively inconsequential, major have a more notable impact on the seed. * Added support for 4 traps (Spam Call, Reverse Controls, Gem Tax, and Damage Sparx)! The first 2 have a customizable length of time they last, and you can customize how much of the junk pool will be traps vs. filler. ## Other Things - Refactored/organized significant chunks of the codebase to be more smartly designed, particularly the item creation process. - Client commands have slightly better error checking now. Also added `/costs` as a convenience command that outputs various costs separately from `/list_options`. - Made an updated logic spreadsheet which lists every region and location access rule. May or may not be useful to the average person, but it's [here](<https://tinyurl.com/ahtapsheet>) for those interested in the internal logic rules (also pinned in the thread). - Map icons now render as red = unreachable, yellow = reachable, green = checked. - Every location was renamed to be less verbose, and they have a new ID mapping system which makes some features *way* easier to code. - Partially undid the custom sorting of locations in the tracker page. Locations are now sorted first in order of vanilla game levels, then alphabetically by logical region, then alphabetically by location. - "Generics" filler category is now called "Shinies". Same thing, they do nothing, just treat them like little shiny trinkets. - Added "Sent <item> to <player>" notifications in-game. None of us have any idea why they weren't there already, either...also added a small Easter egg when you receive a specific type of item from yourself :slight_smile: - Did you know there's some barrels and crates in Stormy Beach you can headbash? I didn't...their gems (270 total) are added to the gem logic system now. - `hint_boss_rewards` now hints all boss locations, not just the breath rewards. - Added location groups for Light Gem doors and gadgets. - Fixed an inconsequential logic bug in Magma Falls Bottom.
[Setup Guide](https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/wiki/Spyro:-AHT-1-%E2%80%90-Setup-Guide-&-FAQ)

# SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE ARCHIPELAGO 0.01 Prerelease
## Changelog - Added deathlink - Made the HACK unlock view show what actually got unlocked - Added a GUI for connecting (accessible in the settings menu) - Stopped the CORE unlock view from ever appearing - Fixed some levels not unlocking the correct paths
## Requirements [BepInEx x86](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/tag/5.4.23.5), verified to work with version 5.4.23.5. NOTE: Most SUPERHOT mods use MelonLoader, however this mod is not compatible with MelonLoader at the moment, however a [tool exists to try and resolves this](https://github.com/toebeann/Tobey.BepInExMelonLoaderWizard). I have not verified this tool
## Install guide - Client: Follow the [BepInEx install guide](https://docs.bepinex.dev/articles/user_guide/installation/index.html), then move the folder listed in the zip under plugins into BepInEx's plugins. - [APWorld install guide](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup_en)
For usage on this mod on this mod, please refer to the [README](https://github.com/Temperz87/SUPERHOT_MCD_Archipelago) on the repositories main page.
## Known bugs If you find any bugs that are not listed here, please report them in the [SHMCD thread in the Archipelago discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1544356897958658059). - CACHE levels do not display outgoing edges when they have not been completed yet - The discs in CACHE levels do not report what hacks you unlock, only what hack the level would unlock if the game was not randomized - Nodes 1A, 1B, and 1C will always appear on the map, even if they are not unreachable - Disconnection from a multiworld will cause unintended side effects - The hack unlock view will pop up, even if nothing got unlocked
> [!NOTE] > This mod natively works on Linux using `Proton Hotfix`, and following [this guide](https://docs.bepinex.dev/articles/advanced/proton_wine.html) to add `winhttp` to your default wineprefix
> [!WARNING] > This mod generates it's own save files in the save directory as the .dll, and does not dip into the main save file at all. However, I take no responsibility if your save file gets somehow deleted or altered.
